messages:
Alina: Heads-up 1 1 1 1 Google marketplace wants a GKE one-click reference for Redwood Dedicated that includes Cloud Armor defaults. I pushed a prototype TF branch: feature/marketplace-gke-armor. Need owners for network, TF hygiene, and the marketplace collateral.
Sam: I can pick up TF + networking review. Share link pls.
Alina: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/compare/feature/marketplace-gke-armor 1 README is barebones, module at modules/gke-marketplace. Need example quickstart, diagram, and marketplace-friendly README.
Priya: Question 1: Should the example expose a public IP directly or route via GCLB with Cloud Armor (preferred for WAF)? Marketplace likes simple installs but security is non-negotiable.
Miguel: Strong vote for GCLB (HTTP(S) LB) + NEG backing the k8s service + Cloud Armor in front. Keeps TLS at LB and allows attaching policy. For private deployments we can show ILB variant.
Sam: OK. I'll refactor module to: create NEG backend, HTTPS LB, managed cert, health checks. Add var to toggle autoprovisioning and ILB mode.
Alina: Marketplace asked we use GKE Standard (not Autopilot) to show node pools and RBAC setup. Can examples include a terraform snippet that creates the cluster and deploys our helm chart?
Sam: Yep. I'll add examples/quickstart-gke with a small tf snippet. Draft snippet for docs: 
```hcl
module "gke_marketplace" {
  source = "../modules/gke-marketplace"
  project = var.project
  region  = var.region
  cluster_name = "redwood-marketplace-gke"
  create_ingress = true
  node_pools = [{ name = "default", node_count = 3 }]
}
```
Priya: For Cloud Armor, propose a starter policy that: enable OWASP rules, block known malicious ASN/IP ranges, and add a simple rate limit for /api/* endpoints. I'll paste the policy snippet in the PR.
Miguel: Make the NEG default container port 8080 and health check path /_health. That reduces copy/paste mistakes for customers. Also include a note about GKE pod security standards.
CI-bot: CI build for feature/marketplace-gke-armor finished: build #122 705 705 passed.
Jordan: I'll produce the architecture SVG and two marketplace listing screenshots (install flow + variables). Sam, can you add outputs: kubeconfig, load_balancer_ip, cloud_armor_policy so I can embed them? Keep outputs minimal.
Sam: Will add outputs + short troubleshooting section for common quota/permission errors (service account roles, API enablement). Also will include an optional var to skip managed cert for cert-manager users.
Alina: TL;DR action items: Sam 1 update module + examples (due EOD Wed). Priya 1 attach Cloud Armor policy + sample rules (due Thu). Miguel 1 validate NEG defaults + smoke deploy in test project (due Thu). Jordan 1 diagrams + screenshots (due Fri). We'll reconvene after PR green. Thanks :thumbsup:
